# External AI Risk Sources

Put additional risk-management source files here.

Recommended folders:

- `mit_ai_risk_repository/` for exports or pages from https://airisk.mit.edu/
- `nist_ai_rmf/` for the NIST AI Risk Management Framework PDF or extracted notes from https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework

Supported file types:

- `.md`
- `.markdown`
- `.txt`
- `.csv`
- `.json`
- `.pdf`

The GovTech app loads these files together with the existing Sandbox LLM Wiki and uses
them in the "AI Pilot Risk Management Agent" mode.
